notes: The margin's *sum* was read and set aside under rule 38.
*as yet* was kept with the preposition rather than marked `added`: it is part of the one temporal expression the ASV writes for `עַד`, and no other morpheme in the clause answers to it.

The two *nor*s go to the waws standing at the heads of the second and third cola under rule 35, not to the single written `לֹא` as a distributed negative: rule 25's own carve-out sends a single word carrying both coordination and negation to the waw.
